title: Qwen Bridge Permission Policy (Tier-1)
description: Maps an arifOS lease.scope to an acpx --permission-policy JSON file. Consumed by qwen_bridge.compile_policy(). Tier-1 only — does not yet encode SABAR cooling, F11 consent gates, or thought-stream redaction (Tier-2/3).

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. Bump on breaking change.

autoApprove.description: ACP tool names auto-approved. Maps to AAA F2 OBSERVE_ONLY reads (read_file, grep, glob) by default.

autoDeny.description: ACP tool names denied. For F11-denied scopes, list everything. For reversible tiers, list only blast-bearing tools (write_file, edit, bash).

defaultAction.description: What to do when a tool is neither auto-approved nor auto-denied. 'escalate' = prompt caller (this is the F2 fail-closed default).

maxTurns.description: Bound on agentic turns per session. Maps from lease.max_turns.

ttlSeconds.description: Idle TTL for queue owner. 0 = keep alive forever (NOT recommended). Maps from lease.ttl_seconds.

thoughtStreamAllowed.description: If true, agent_thought_chunk events are emitted to the log. If false (default F2 fail-closed), thoughts are dropped to prevent reasoning leakage. Maps from lease.consent.thought_stream.

reasoningClass.description: Truth-class tag the bridge applies to all Qwen outputs by default. AUTO = bridge infers from content shape (text → INT, file path → OBS).

bridgeFloor.description: Minimum arifOS floor this policy respects. Used by compile_policy() to widen autoApprove/autoDeny as needed.
